nodes.label: Hailo-8L Host Driver Installer
nodes.rationale: Builds and installs the hailort PCIe kernel driver on the host (not in the container) at pinned version 4.21.0, because the accelerator needs a host kernel module and firmware in /lib/firmware/hailo. Explicitly diagnoses Secure Boot key rejection as the common modprobe failure, and installs dkms only on trixie.
